svg.title: Empty operations chairs receive no page
svg.desc: Show genuinely empty chairs and an unoccupied paging destination. No silhouette, hand or acknowledged-screen state should invent a human ignoring an alert. Use the distinct paging recess and tiled display wall; the setting itself supplies neither a recipient nor an acknowledgment.
